attributes.context: The same section states that bargaining unit work shall not include work that bargaining unit employees do not possess the skills or have the appropriate equipment to perform.

extraction_text: Notwithstanding the above, the parties acknowledge that work processes and methods evolve. The City shall continue to provide employees with the necessary equipment and training to perform work that is a logical and reasonable advancement of the work covered by this agreement, provided the money to pay for the necessary equipment and/or skills is either within the bureaus' budget and they are authorized to spend it in this manner or the expenditure is approved by City Council.

attributes.context: The sentence appears in the Pay Day section, which also states payday is biweekly, no more than six days' pay is held back, and employees are paid prior to the end of their assigned shift.

extraction_text: Prior to implementing direct deposit the Union and City will meet to review the procedures and reporting requirements for direct deposit.
